properties.headline: Wildfire with IMMEDIATE EVACUATION for parts of Comanche County between Indiahoma and Cache.
properties.description:
At 4:50pm (1650)  a large and destructive wildfire was burning out of
control between Indiahom and Cache and spreading rapidly northward.
Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY to the
north towards Cache.
properties.instruction:
Those between Lee Road and Rogers Lane to the north and south and Post Oak Road and Quanah Road to the west and east should LEAVE this area NOW to avoid injury or death. Do not delay packing
belongings. Reunification Center is setting up at the New Life Assembly of God at 501 W B Ave  Cache  OK.
Roads in the area may be impacted by fire and smoke. Never drive
into heavy smoke. SLOW DOWN & MOVE OVER for emergency vehicles.

CMAMtext: Comanche Co EM: EVACUATION ORDER west of Cache for a wildfire. LEAVE NOW to the North.
CMAMlongtext: Comanche County EM: A large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control between Indiahoma and Cache, and spreading rapidly northward. Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety, EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY to the north towards New Life Assembly in Cache.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 29 at 5:29PM CDT until August 30 at 9:10AM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following river in Illinois...
Indiana...

Wabash River at Hutsonville to Vincennes

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River from Hutsonville down
to Vincennes. The river has crested. Flooding should come to an end
on the Wabash over the weekend.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Vincennes.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 17.0 feet, Considerable agricultural flooding extends
from just north of the junction of Illinois 33 with Business 50 to
the St. Francesville, Illinois area.  River Road from Lincoln
Memorial Bridge to Billett Rd is impassable.  Extensive seep water
forms behind Illinois levees extending from Russellville to U.S.
Highway 50.  Flooding of agricultural land begins in Knox County
Indiana west of the railroad extending for the Oaktown area to the
north side of Vincennes.  Extensive flooding of Small Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 4:45 PM CDT /5:45 PM EDT/ Saturday the stage was 16.8 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 4:45 PM CDT /5:45 PM EDT/ Saturday was 17.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
this evening and continue falling to 4.4 feet Tuesday, September
08.
- Flood stage is 16.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued Sunday morning at 915 AM CDT /1015
AM EDT/.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 4:26PM MST until August 29 at 7:30PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 730 PM MST.

* At 426 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible
in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Kitt Peak and Pan Tak.

This includes Route 86 between mile markers 132 and 149.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain.
Washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 6:45 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 29 at 6:27PM CDT until August 29 at 9:30PM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Edmunds County in north central South
Dakota...
Southeastern Walworth County in north central South Dakota...

* WHEN...Until 930 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 623 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly
in the warned area.
- Radar estimates between a half inch to 3 inches have fallen,
though total amounts are currently unknown. As storms continue to
develop and move over the same areas, more rainfall is expected
to add to what has already fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Southwestern Edmunds and Southeastern
Walworth Counties.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 4:21PM MST until August 29 at 6:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 421 PM MST, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms producing
heavy rain and flash flooding across the warned area. Between 0.75
and 1.25 inches of rain in 30 minutes was estimated by radar earlier.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams and
normally dry washes.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Pima Point, Hermit's Rest, Monument Creek Vista, Hopi Point,
Maricopa Point, South Rim Visitors Center, Pipe Creek Resthouse,
Pipe Creek Vista, Yaki Point, Grand Canyon Village, Plateau Point,
South Rim, Devil?s Corkscrew and Skeleton Point.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 85 and 87...and
between river miles 90 and 98.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Havasupai Gardens Campground, Mather Campground, Clear Creek Camp
Site, Below Clear Creek Camp Site, Zoroaster Camp Site, Above
Cremation Camp Site, Below Pipe Creek Camp Site, 91 Mile Creek Camp
Site, Trinity Creek Camp Site, Above Salt Creek Camp Site, Salt Creek
Camp Site, Granite Camp Site, Lower Granite Camp Site, 94 Mile Canyon
Camp Site, Hermit Camp Site, Old Dune Camp Site, Bull Schist Camp
Site, Schist Camp Site, Upper Boucher Camp Site, Boucher Camp Site
and Pipe Creek Rest Area.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Bright Angel Creek, Colorado River, 91- Mile Creek, Zoroaster
Canyon, Heather Wash, Sapphire Canyon, Slate Creek, Clear Creek,
Travertine Canyon, Monument Creek, Cremation Creek, Coconino Wash,
Pipe Creek, Boucher Creek, Agate Canyon, 94- Mile Creek, Ninetyone
Mile Creek, Crystal Creek, Trinity Creek, Lonetree Canyon, Hermit
Creek, Horn Creek, Bright Angel Wash, Salt Creek and Garden Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 29 at 6:30PM CDT until August 29 at 7:30PM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
SVRABR

The National Weather Service in Aberdeen has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southwestern Edmunds County in north central South Dakota...
Northeastern Potter County in north central South Dakota...
Southeastern Walworth County in north central South Dakota...

* Until 730 PM CDT.

* At 630 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles southeast
of Lowry, or 7 miles west of Hoven, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Hoven around 655 PM CDT.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 29 at 7:37PM EDT until August 29 at 7:45PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
The storm which prompted the warning has weakened below severe
limits, and no longer poses an immediate threat to life or property.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.  However, gusty
winds and heavy rain are still possible with this thunderstorm.

NWSheadline: THE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING FOR SOUTHERN COLUMBIA COUNTY WILL EXPIRE AT 745 PM EDT

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 29 at 5:37PM MDT until August 29 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
At 537 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 16 miles northeast
of Lake Powell, or 44 miles southeast of Escalante, moving east at 35
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Lake Powell.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 29 at 6:41PM EDT until August 29 at 7:45PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...

* Until 745 PM EDT.

* At 641 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Suwannee
River, moving northwest at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots...suddenly higher
waves...frequent lightning...and heavy downpours. Make
sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Suwannee River.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
